# Director for AI agents

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs/agents-doc.ts from the tool catalog. Do not edit by hand: run `npx tsx scripts/docs/agents-doc.ts`. -->

Director exposes every editing operation as a tool an AI assistant can call: 98 tools, from reading the timeline to cutting, grading, captioning, mixing and exporting. The same catalog is served over MCP (HTTP and stdio) and plain HTTP, and the app runs every call against the project open in its window, so the person sees each change as it happens.

## Connect

In Director open Settings (Cmd+,), turn on **Connect an AI**, and copy the setup for your app:

- **Claude Code**: one command, `claude mcp add --transport http director http://127.0.0.1:47615/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer <token>"`.
- **Claude Desktop**: a JSON entry for Settings, Developer, Edit Config. It launches the bridge bundled with Director (`mcp-stdio.cjs`, run by the Director binary in Node mode), which forwards to the running app.
- **Other MCP apps**: an HTTP server entry with the URL and an `Authorization: Bearer` header.
- **Any AI over HTTP**: `GET /api/tools?format=anthropic|openai|mcp` returns the tool definitions; `POST /api/tools/<name>` with a JSON body runs one and returns `{ ok, data }` or `{ ok: false, error: { code, message, hint } }`. Send `X-Director-Client: <your name>` to label your changes.

Settings shows the exact snippet with your token. The token is private: anyone with it on this Mac can edit your projects. New token disconnects every app.

## The assistant inside Director

Director also has its own chat: the **Assistant** panel in the Edit workspace (Cmd+J). Type what you want in your own words and Claude works through it with this same catalog, using your API key from Settings. It needs no connection setup, follows the same Ask and Auto modes, and labels its changes "Assistant" so the Agent panel can revert them.

Inside the app only text reaches Anthropic: your messages, the transcript and what the tools report. File paths are replaced with `[path]`, media file names lose their extension, and the tools that return pictures or need file paths (`render_frame`, `render_contact_sheet`, `import_media`, `browse_files`) are left out. An assistant connected over MCP runs on your side of the connection, so it can use every tool.

## Safety

- Listens on 127.0.0.1 only, needs the bearer token, refuses browser origins and foreign Host headers.
- **Ask mode** (default): every change waits for the person to click Accept in Director; reads never ask. **Auto mode**: changes apply at once. In both, every change is one undo step labelled with the assistant's name, and the Agent panel lists everything and can revert all agent changes in one step while keeping the person's own edits.
- `propose_edits` always asks, whatever the mode.
- No tool deletes files. Exports are written only inside the export folder, never over an existing file. Imports accept existing media files only.

## How to work

- Start with `get_started`, then `get_timeline` and `get_transcript`.
- Times are **seconds** on the timeline (edit positions snap to the nearest frame). Positions are project pixels from the frame center (+x right, +y down). Volume is dB. Ids come from read tools and change when clips are split or re-created, so read again after structural edits.
- Every edit tool accepts `dryRun` (preview what would change) and `expectRevision` (refuse if the project changed since you read it; every read returns `revision`).
- `batch` runs several edit tools as one atomic step and one approval. If a step fails, nothing changes and the error names the step.
- See your work with `render_contact_sheet` (a grid of frames) and `render_frame`.
- Errors say what went wrong and how to fix it (often naming the tool to call).

## MCP resources and prompts

- Resource `director://guide`: What is open, the permission mode, units, a professional workflow and every tool by group.
- Resource `director://timeline`: The open project with every clip in full detail.
- Resource `director://transcript`: What is said, word by word with times and indices.
- Resource `director://capabilities`: Effects with parameter ranges, transitions, animations, caption styles and presets.
- Resource `director://media`: Imported media in the project bin.
- Prompt `edit_reel` (Edit this into a reel): Turn the open recording into a tight, captioned short-form reel. Arguments: `goal`, `length`.
- Prompt `tighten_pacing` (Tighten the pacing): Remove dead air, fillers and repeats, and keep the energy up. Arguments: `referenceId`.
- Prompt `caption_and_title` (Captions and titles): Add captions and on-screen titles that match a style. Arguments: `style`.
- Prompt `color_and_sound` (Color and sound pass): Grade every shot consistently and mix the audio. Arguments: `look`.
- Prompt `match_reference` (Match a reference reel): Edit toward the pacing and structure of a Swipe reference. Arguments: `referenceId`.

## Creative vocabulary

| Effect | Parameters (range, unit) |
|---|---|
| `color` Color | `exposure` -2 to 2, default 0; `contrast` -1 to 1, default 0; `saturation` -1 to 1, default 0; `temperature` -1 to 1, default 0; `tint` -1 to 1, default 0; `brightness` -0.5 to 0.5, default 0 |
| `lut` LUT | `strength` 0 to 1, default 1 |
| `blur` Blur | `radius` 0 to 40 px, default 10 |
| `vignette` Vignette | `amount` 0 to 1, default 0.5 |
| `zoom` Punch-in zoom | `at` 0 to 600 seconds from clip start, default 0; `amount` 1 to 2 x, default 1.15; `ramp` 0 to 2 seconds from clip start, default 0.12; `until` 0 to 600 seconds from clip start |
| `shake` Shake | `amount` 0 to 60 px, default 12; `frequency` 1 to 30, default 9 |
| `chromakey` Chroma key | `similarity` 0 to 1, default 0.3; `smoothness` 0 to 0.5, default 0.1 |
| `mask` Mask | `x` 0 to 1, default 0.1; `y` 0 to 1, default 0.1; `w` 0 to 1, default 0.8; `h` 0 to 1, default 0.8; `feather` 0 to 0.5, default 0.05 |

Transitions: `crossfade`, `dissolve`, `dip-black`, `dip-white`, `slide-left`, `slide-up`, `zoom`, `whip`. Text animations: `fade`, `pop`, `slide-up`, `slide-left`, `zoom`, `typewriter`. Caption styles: `word-pop`, `karaoke`, `boxed`, `clean`, `bold-yellow`. Speed ramps: `montage`, `hero`, `bullet`, `ease-in`, `ease-out`. Export presets: `reels-30`, `reels-60`, `youtube-1080`, `youtube-4k`, `square-1080`.

## Getting started

### `get_started`: Start here

Orientation for a new session: what is open, the permission mode (ask: each change waits for the person to approve it in Director; auto: changes apply at once, all undoable), the units, a professional workflow, and every tool by group. Call this first.

*Reads only; never asks.*

No arguments.

Example: `{}`

### `get_capabilities`: What the editor can do

The creative vocabulary with exact names, ranges and units: effects and every parameter, transitions, text animations, caption styles, speed-ramp presets, layouts, keyframe properties, eases, blend and fit modes, canvas and export presets, lane and marker kinds. topic narrows it (effects, transitions, captionStyles, exportPresets, ...).

*Reads only; never asks.*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `topic` | string |  | Narrow to one topic |

Example: `{}`
Example: `{"topic":"effects"}`

### `describe_tool`: Explain a tool

A tool's full description, JSON schema of its arguments, examples, and whether it changes the project.

*Reads only; never asks.*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | Name |

Example: `{"name":"add_effect"}`

## Reading the project

### `get_timeline`: Read the timeline

The open project: name, canvas, length, revision, lanes with their clips (ids, times in seconds, media, text, effects, transitions) and markers. detail:"full" adds every clip property (transform, keyframes, effect params, audio, text style). Narrow with lanes (ids, names, or kinds; a kind lists every lane of that kind) and a time window (from/to seconds).

*Reads only; never asks.*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `detail` | "summary" \| "full" |  | "summary" (default) or "full" (every clip property) |
| `lanes` | string[] |  | Lane ids or kinds |
| `from` | number (0 to 36000) |  | Start of the range, timeline seconds |
| `to` | number (0 to 36000) |  | End of the range, timeline seconds |

Example: `{}`
Example: `{"detail":"full","lanes":["camera"],"from":0,"to":10}`

### `get_clip`: Read one clip

Every property of a clip: times and source range (seconds), media info, speed, transform with keyframes (timeline and clip seconds), effects with parameters, audio mix, text and style, transition.

*Reads only; never asks.*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clip` | string | yes | Clip id (from get_timeline) |

Example: `{"clip":"clip_abc"}`

### `list_media`: List imported media

The project bin: each media item's id, name, kind (video, audio, image), duration (s), size, fps, whether it has audio, its role, whether it is transcribed, and how many clips use it. includePaths adds file paths on this Mac.

*Reads only; never asks.*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `includePaths` | boolean |  | Also return file paths on this Mac |

Example: `{}`

### `get_transcript`: Read what is said

Transcript words as they fall on the current timeline (after cuts), each with its index (for cut_words), text, start and end in seconds and clip id, plus phrases (sentences) with times. Narrow with from/to seconds.

*Reads only; never asks.*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | number (0 to 36000) |  | Start of the range, timeline seconds |
| `to` | number (0 to 36000) |  | End of the range, timeline seconds |

Example: `{}`
Example: `{"from":0,"to":5}`

### `find_in_transcript`: Find words

Find where a word or phrase is said (ignoring case and punctuation): every occurrence with its timeline start/end in seconds, word indices for cut_words, and the surrounding words.

*Reads only; never asks.*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | yes | The words |
| `context` | integer (0 to 30) |  | Words of context each side (default 5) |

Example: `{"text":"link in bio"}`

### `analyze_pacing`: Measure pacing

Pacing of the edit: length, shots (camera, screen and b-roll changes and zooms), average and median shot length, cuts per minute, first cut time, words per second and per minute, share of runtime with speech. With referenceId (a Swipe reference from list_references) it compares metric by metric and says what to change.

*Reads only; never asks.*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `referenceId` | string |  | Swipe reference id (from list_references) |

Example: `{}`
Example: `{"referenceId":"ref_123"}`

### `get_project`: Get project (compatibility)

The open project as a short text summary plus lanes, clips (no file paths), markers and script. Kept for clients written for the first version of this bridge; get_timeline is richer.

*Reads only; never asks.*

No arguments.

Example: `{}`

### `list_ops`: List edit actions (compatibility)

The edit-action vocabulary that propose_edits accepts, with its rules. Kept for clients written for the first version of this bridge.

*Reads only; never asks.*

No arguments.

Example: `{}`

## Undo and batches

### `propose_edits`: Propose edits for approval

Propose a set of high-level edit actions (cut, zoom, broll, text, marker; times in seconds) or primitive ops. Director validates them, shows them to the person and always waits for Accept or Reject, whatever the mode. Applies as one undo step.

*Changes the project (one undo step; asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `summary` | string | yes | What this change does, shown to the person |
| `actions` | object[] |  | High-level actions: cut, zoom, broll, text, marker (seconds) |
| `ops` | any[] |  | Primitive ops as in the project file (times in microseconds) |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Preview: return what would change without changing anything |
| `expectRevision` | integer (at least 0) |  | Refuse if the project changed since you read this revision (from any read tool) |

Example: `{"summary":"Tighten the hook","actions":[{"type":"cut","start":1.9,"end":2.7,"reason":"Dead air after the hook"}]}`

### `apply_ops`: Apply primitive ops (advanced)

Escape hatch: apply primitive project ops exactly as stored in the project file (addClip, updateClip, removeClip, moveClipToLane, addLane, updateLane, removeLane, moveLane, addMarker, updateMarker, removeMarker, addMedia, updateMedia, removeMedia, setCanvas, setMeta). Times here are MICROSECONDS, unlike every other tool. Prefer the named tools; use this only for something they cannot express.

*Changes the project (one undo step; asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ops` | any[] | yes | Primitive ops as in the project file (times in microseconds) |
| `summary` | string | yes | What this change does, shown to the person |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Preview: return what would change without changing anything |
| `expectRevision` | integer (at least 0) |  | Refuse if the project changed since you read this revision (from any read tool) |

Example: `{"summary":"Rename","ops":[{"op":"setMeta","patch":{"name":"Final cut"}}]}`

### `batch`: Several edits as one step

Run several edit tools in order as ONE atomic change (one undo step, one approval). Each step sees the result of the steps before it, so later steps can use ids created earlier only if you know them in advance; steps that return new ids (add_text, split...) are best followed by a fresh read. If any step fails, nothing is changed and the error names the step. Read and app tools cannot be batched.

*Changes the project (one undo step; asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | string | yes | What the batch does, shown to the person and in undo |
| `steps` | object[] | yes | Edit tool calls to run in order: { tool, args } |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Preview: return what would change without changing anything |
| `expectRevision` | integer (at least 0) |  | Refuse if the project changed since you read this revision (from any read tool) |

Example: `{"label":"Grade and title the hook","steps":[{"tool":"add_effect","args":{"clips":["clip_abc"],"type":"color","params":{"contrast":0.2}}},{"tool":"add_text","args":{"text":"Watch this","start":0,"duration":2}}]}`

### `get_history`: Undo history

The undo and redo stacks (most recent first) with their labels, how many steps agents made, and the current revision.

*Reads only; never asks.*

No arguments.

Example: `{}`

### `undo`: Undo

Undo the last `steps` changes (default 1), whoever made them. get_history shows what they are.

*Acts in the app or writes files (asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `steps` | integer (1 to 100) |  | Edit tool calls to run in order: { tool, args } |

Example: `{}`

### `redo`: Redo

Redo the last `steps` undone changes (default 1). Anything new done after an undo clears what can be redone.

*Acts in the app or writes files (asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `steps` | integer (1 to 100) |  | Edit tool calls to run in order: { tool, args } |

Example: `{}`

### `revert_agent_changes`: Revert all agent changes

Take back every change agents made in this session in one step, keeping the person's own edits. Itself undoable.

*Acts in the app or writes files (asks first in Ask mode).*

No arguments.

Example: `{}`

## Cutting and arranging

### `add_clip`: Place media on the timeline

Put an imported media item (from list_media) on a lane. Times in seconds. sourceIn/sourceOut pick the part of the file to use (default: all of it; images default to 3 s, or set duration). By default the clip overwrites whatever is under it on its lane; insert:true pushes everything after it later instead (ripple insert). Lane defaults to the natural lane for the media (camera, screen, broll, voice, music or sfx).

*Changes the project (one undo step; asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `media` | string | yes | Media id (or exact name) from list_media |
| `lane` | string |  | Lane id, or a lane kind (camera, screen, broll, graphics, titles, captions, voice, music, sfx) |
| `start` | number (0 to 36000) |  | Timeline position in seconds (default: end of the lane) |
| `sourceIn` | number (0 to 36000) |  | Seconds into the file where the clip starts (default 0) |
| `sourceOut` | number (0 to 36000) |  | Seconds into the file where the clip ends (default: end of file) |
| `duration` | number (at most 36000) |  | Length in seconds (images and when sourceOut is not given) |
| `insert` | boolean |  | Ripple insert: push later clips on all lanes to make room (default false: overwrite) |
| `name` | string |  | Name |
| `fit` | "cover" \| "contain" \| "stretch" |  | How it fills the frame (default cover; screen recordings default contain) |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Preview: return what would change without changing anything |
| `expectRevision` | integer (at least 0) |  | Refuse if the project changed since you read this revision (from any read tool) |

Example (3 s of b-roll at 4.5 s): `{"media":"media_1","lane":"broll","start":4.5,"sourceIn":10,"sourceOut":13}`
Example: `{"media":"media_2","insert":true,"start":0}`

### `split`: Split clips

Cut clips in two at a timeline time (seconds; snapped to the nearest frame). With no clips or lanes given it is the blade-all tool: every unlocked clip under that time is cut. Linked clips (camera plus its detached audio) are cut together. Returns the ids of the new right-hand parts.

*Changes the project (one undo step; asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `at` | number (0 to 36000) | yes | Timeline time in seconds |
| `clips` | string[] |  | Only these clips (and their linked partners) |
| `lanes` | string[] |  | Only clips on these lanes |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Preview: return what would change without changing anything |
| `expectRevision` | integer (at least 0) |  | Refuse if the project changed since you read this revision (from any read tool) |

Example: `{"at":5.2}`
Example: `{"at":5.2,"clips":["clip_abc"]}`

### `trim_clip`: Trim a clip edge

Move the start or end edge of a clip. Give `to` (timeline seconds where the edge should land) or `by` (seconds to move it; positive moves later). ripple:true (default) moves later clips on the same lane so no gap or overlap appears; ripple:false leaves them in place. Edges cannot extend past the source media.

*Changes the project (one undo step; asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clip` | string | yes | Clip id (from get_timeline) |
| `edge` | "start" \| "end" | yes | Which edge of the clip |
| `to` | number (0 to 36000) |  | Timeline time for the edge |
| `by` | number (-36000 to 36000) |  | Move the edge by this many seconds |
| `ripple` | boolean |  | Close or open space after the clip on its lane (default true) |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Preview: return what would change without changing anything |
| `expectRevision` | integer (at least 0) |  | Refuse if the project changed since you read this revision (from any read tool) |

Example (Shorten by half a second): `{"clip":"clip_abc","edge":"end","by":-0.5}`
Example: `{"clip":"clip_abc","edge":"start","to":2,"ripple":false}`

### `move_clip`: Move a clip

Move a clip to a new start time and/or another lane of a compatible kind. Give `start` (timeline seconds) or `by` (seconds; negative is earlier). Linked partners move by the same amount. The clip overwrites whatever is at its destination (like a drag in the timeline).

*Changes the project (one undo step; asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clip` | string | yes | Clip id (from get_timeline) |
| `start` | number (0 to 36000) |  | Timeline start in seconds |
| `by` | number (-36000 to 36000) |  | Seconds to move by (negative is earlier) |
| `lane` | string |  | Destination lane (default: stay) |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Preview: return what would change without changing anything |
| `expectRevision` | integer (at least 0) |  | Refuse if the project changed since you read this revision (from any read tool) |

Example: `{"clip":"clip_abc","start":12}`
Example: `{"clip":"clip_abc","by":-0.25,"lane":"graphics"}`

### `delete_clips`: Delete clips

Remove clips (with their linked partners). ripple:true (default) closes the gap on their lanes; ripple:false leaves an empty gap. Undoable.

*Changes the project (one undo step; asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clips` | string[] | yes | Clip ids (from get_timeline) |
| `ripple` | boolean |  | Move later clips to close or open the space (default true) |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Preview: return what would change without changing anything |
| `expectRevision` | integer (at least 0) |  | Refuse if the project changed since you read this revision (from any read tool) |

Example: `{"clips":["clip_abc"]}`
Example: `{"clips":["clip_a","clip_b"],"ripple":false}`

### `delete_range`: Delete a time range

Remove everything between two timeline times (seconds). ripple:true (default) closes the gap on every unlocked lane, keeping picture, sound and captions in sync; markers inside go and later ones move. ripple:false lifts the content and leaves a gap. Restrict to some lanes with `lanes`. Use several `ranges` to make many cuts at once.

*Changes the project (one undo step; asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | number (0 to 36000) |  | Start of the range, timeline seconds |
| `to` | number (0 to 36000) |  | End of the range, timeline seconds |
| `ranges` | object[] |  | Several ranges at once (instead of from/to) |
| `lanes` | string[] |  | Lane ids or kinds |
| `ripple` | boolean |  | Move later clips to close or open the space (default true) |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Preview: return what would change without changing anything |
| `expectRevision` | integer (at least 0) |  | Refuse if the project changed since you read this revision (from any read tool) |

Example: `{"from":3.6,"to":4.65}`
Example: `{"ranges":[{"from":1,"to":1.4},{"from":7.2,"to":8}]}`
Example: `{"from":10,"to":12,"lanes":["broll"],"ripple":false}`

### `close_gaps`: Close empty gaps

Remove stretches of the timeline where no lane has anything (black, silent gaps), pulling everything after them earlier. Gaps shorter than minGap seconds are kept.

*Changes the project (one undo step; asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `minGap` | number (0 to 60) |  | Ignore gaps shorter than this (seconds, default 0.04) |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Preview: return what would change without changing anything |
| `expectRevision` | integer (at least 0) |  | Refuse if the project changed since you read this revision (from any read tool) |

Example: `{}`

### `slip_clip`: Slip a clip

Keep a clip where it is on the timeline but show a different part of its source: by > 0 shows later material, by < 0 earlier (seconds). Clamped to the source media.

*Changes the project (one undo step; asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clip` | string | yes | Clip id (from get_timeline) |
| `by` | number (-36000 to 36000) | yes | Seconds to move by (negative is earlier) |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Preview: return what would change without changing anything |
| `expectRevision` | integer (at least 0) |  | Refuse if the project changed since you read this revision (from any read tool) |

Example: `{"clip":"clip_abc","by":1.5}`

### `roll_edit`: Roll an edit point

Move the cut between two adjacent clips on the same lane by `by` seconds (positive: the left clip gets longer and the right one shorter). The total length stays the same.

*Changes the project (one undo step; asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `left` | string | yes | Clip on the left of the edit point |
| `right` | string | yes | Clip on the right of the edit point |
| `by` | number (-36000 to 36000) | yes | Seconds to move by (negative is earlier) |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Preview: return what would change without changing anything |
| `expectRevision` | integer (at least 0) |  | Refuse if the project changed since you read this revision (from any read tool) |

Example: `{"left":"clip_a","right":"clip_b","by":0.2}`

### `duplicate_clip`: Duplicate a clip

Copy a clip (with all its effects, keyframes and text) to `at` seconds on the same lane, or right after itself.

*Changes the project (one undo step; asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clip` | string | yes | Clip id (from get_timeline) |
| `at` | number (0 to 36000) |  | Timeline time in seconds |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Preview: return what would change without changing anything |
| `expectRevision` | integer (at least 0) |  | Refuse if the project changed since you read this revision (from any read tool) |

Example: `{"clip":"clip_abc"}`
Example: `{"clip":"clip_abc","at":20}`

### `link_clips`: Link or unlink clips

Link clips so they move, split and delete together (for example a camera clip and its separate audio), or unlink them with link:false.

*Changes the project (one undo step; asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clips` | string[] | yes | Clip ids (from get_timeline) |
| `link` | boolean |  | true (default) links, false unlinks |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Preview: return what would change without changing anything |
| `expectRevision` | integer (at least 0) |  | Refuse if the project changed since you read this revision (from any read tool) |

Example: `{"clips":["clip_video","clip_audio"]}`
Example: `{"clips":["clip_video"],"link":false}`

## Clip properties, motion and speed

### `set_clip`: Set clip properties

Set static properties of one or more clips: position x/y (pixels from the frame center, +x right, +y down), scale (1 = fills the frame per fit), rotation (degrees), opacity (0 to 1), crop (fractions of each side), flips, fit, blend mode, reverse playback, enabled (false hides and silences it), name and label color. Setting a property that has keyframes replaces the animation with the fixed value; use set_keyframes to animate.

*Changes the project (one undo step; asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clips` | string[] | yes | Clip ids (from get_timeline) |
| `x` | number |  | Pixels from the frame center, + is right |
| `y` | number |  | Pixels from the frame center, + is down |
| `scale` | number (0.01 to 20) |  | 1 fills the frame (per fit) |
| `rotation` | number (-3600 to 3600) |  | Degrees |
| `opacity` | number (0 to 1) |  | 0 transparent to 1 opaque |
| `crop` | object |  | Fraction cut from each side |
| `flipH` | boolean |  | Mirror left to right |
| `flipV` | boolean |  | Mirror top to bottom |
| `fit` | "cover" \| "contain" \| "stretch" |  | How media fills the frame |
| `blend` | "normal" \| "screen" \| "multiply" \| "overlay" \| "add" |  | Blend mode |
| `reverse` | boolean |  | Play backwards |
| `enabled` | boolean |  | On (true) or off (false) |
| `name` | string |  | Name |
| `color` | string |  | Timeline label color |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Preview: return what would change without changing anything |
| `expectRevision` | integer (at least 0) |  | Refuse if the project changed since you read this revision (from any read tool) |

Example (Punch in 20% and move up): `{"clips":["clip_abc"],"scale":1.2,"y":-80}`
Example: `{"clips":["clip_abc"],"crop":{"left":0.1,"right":0.1},"opacity":0.8}`

### `set_keyframes`: Animate a property

Animate a clip property with keyframes: x, y (pixels from center), scale, rotation (degrees), opacity (0-1), volume (dB) or an effect parameter (property:"effect" with effect id and param, e.g. a color exposure ramp). Keyframe times are timeline seconds unless timeBase is "clip". Values between keyframes follow each keyframe's ease (linear, ease, easeIn, easeOut, hold). An empty keyframes list removes the animation and keeps the first value.

*Changes the project (one undo step; asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clip` | string | yes | Clip id (from get_timeline) |
| `property` | "x" \| "y" \| "scale" \| "rotation" \| "opacity" \| "volume" \| "effect" | yes | What to animate |
| `effect` | string |  | For property "effect": the effect id (from get_clip) or type |
| `param` | string |  | For property "effect": the parameter, e.g. exposure, amount, radius |
| `keyframes` | object[] | yes | Keyframes: time in seconds, value, and the ease into the next one |
| `timeBase` | "timeline" \| "clip" |  | "timeline" (default): keyframe times are timeline seconds; "clip": seconds from the clip start |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Preview: return what would change without changing anything |
| `expectRevision` | integer (at least 0) |  | Refuse if the project changed since you read this revision (from any read tool) |

Example (Slow push-in): `{"clip":"clip_abc","property":"scale","keyframes":[{"time":2,"value":1},{"time":4,"value":1.3,"ease":"easeOut"}]}`
Example: `{"clip":"clip_title","property":"y","timeBase":"clip","keyframes":[{"time":0,"value":300},{"time":0.4,"value":0}]}`
Example (Dip the music): `{"clip":"clip_music","property":"volume","keyframes":[{"time":10,"value":-6},{"time":12,"value":-30}]}`

### `set_speed`: Change speed

Change a media clip's playback speed. Give `rate` (0.05 to 20; 2 = twice as fast) for a constant speed, `ramp` for a preset speed ramp (montage, hero, bullet, ease-in, ease-out), or `points` for a custom ramp over the clip (at 0 to 1 of its length). ripple:true (default) moves later clips on the lane to follow the new length. preservePitch keeps voices natural (constant speed only).

*Changes the project (one undo step; asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clip` | string | yes | Clip id (from get_timeline) |
| `rate` | number (0.05 to 20) |  | Speed multiplier (2 is twice as fast, 0.5 half speed) |
| `ramp` | "montage" \| "hero" \| "bullet" \| "ease-in" \| "ease-out" |  | Speed ramp preset |
| `points` | object[] |  | Custom ramp: the rate at positions 0 to 1 along the clip |
| `preservePitch` | boolean |  | Keep voices at their natural pitch |
| `ripple` | boolean |  | Move later clips to close or open the space (default true) |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Preview: return what would change without changing anything |
| `expectRevision` | integer (at least 0) |  | Refuse if the project changed since you read this revision (from any read tool) |

Example: `{"clip":"clip_abc","rate":1.25}`
Example: `{"clip":"clip_broll","ramp":"hero"}`
Example: `{"clip":"clip_broll","points":[{"at":0,"rate":1},{"at":0.5,"rate":4},{"at":1,"rate":1}]}`

### `freeze_frame`: Freeze frame

Hold the frame of a video clip at `at` (timeline seconds) for `duration` seconds (default 1). Everything after moves later to make room.

*Changes the project (one undo step; asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clip` | string | yes | Clip id (from get_timeline) |
| `at` | number (0 to 36000) | yes | Timeline time in seconds |
| `duration` | number (0.04 to 60) |  | Length in seconds |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Preview: return what would change without changing anything |
| `expectRevision` | integer (at least 0) |  | Refuse if the project changed since you read this revision (from any read tool) |

Example: `{"clip":"clip_abc","at":3.5,"duration":1.5}`

### `detach_audio`: Detach audio

Split the sound of a video clip onto an audio lane (default voice) as a separate, linked clip, and mute the video clip's own sound. Use it to J/L-cut, clean up or mix the voice separately.

*Changes the project (one undo step; asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clip` | string | yes | Clip id (from get_timeline) |
| `lane` | string |  | Lane id, or a lane kind (camera, screen, broll, graphics, titles, captions, voice, music, sfx) |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Preview: return what would change without changing anything |
| `expectRevision` | integer (at least 0) |  | Refuse if the project changed since you read this revision (from any read tool) |

Example: `{"clip":"clip_camera"}`

### `set_layout`: Picture-in-picture layout

Place a visual clip in a preset layout: full, top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right (small corner picture-in-picture), split-top or split-bottom (half the frame each, for reaction or screen-plus-face shots). Put the overlay on a lane above the main shot.

*Changes the project (one undo step; asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clip` | string | yes | Clip id (from get_timeline) |
| `layout` | "full" \| "top-left" \| "top-right" \| "bottom-left" \| "bottom-right" \| "split-top" \| "split-bottom" | yes | Layout preset |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Preview: return what would change without changing anything |
| `expectRevision` | integer (at least 0) |  | Refuse if the project changed since you read this revision (from any read tool) |

Example: `{"clip":"clip_face","layout":"bottom-right"}`
Example: `{"clip":"clip_screen","layout":"split-top"}`

## Effects, color and transitions

### `add_effect`: Add an effect

Add an effect to one or more clips: color, lut, blur, vignette, zoom, shake, chromakey, mask. Parameters you leave out take their defaults. Time parameters (zoom at/ramp/until) are seconds from the clip start. lut needs params.path (absolute path to a .cube file). get_capabilities {"topic":"effects"} lists every parameter with range and unit. Returns the new effect ids per clip.

*Changes the project (one undo step; asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clips` | string[] | yes | Clip ids (from get_timeline) |
| `type` | "color" \| "lut" \| "blur" \| "vignette" \| "zoom" \| "shake" \| "chromakey" \| "mask" | yes | Type |
| `params` | object |  | Parameters by name; get_capabilities lists each with its range. Time parameters are seconds from the clip start |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Preview: return what would change without changing anything |
| `expectRevision` | integer (at least 0) |  | Refuse if the project changed since you read this revision (from any read tool) |

Example (Warm, punchy grade): `{"clips":["clip_abc"],"type":"color","params":{"exposure":0.2,"contrast":0.15,"saturation":0.1,"temperature":0.1}}`
Example (Punch in at 2.4 s into the clip, release at 4 s): `{"clips":["clip_abc"],"type":"zoom","params":{"at":2.4,"amount":1.2,"ramp":0.15,"until":4}}`
Example: `{"clips":["clip_abc"],"type":"vignette","params":{"amount":0.35}}`

### `update_effect`: Change an effect

Change parameters of an effect on a clip (by effect id, or by type for the first of that type), switch it on or off with enabled, or move it in the stack with index (effects apply top to bottom). Setting a parameter replaces any keyframes on it.

*Changes the project (one undo step; asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clip` | string | yes | Clip id (from get_timeline) |
| `effect` | string | yes | Effect id from get_clip, or its type |
| `params` | object |  | Parameters by name; get_capabilities lists each with its range. Time parameters are seconds from the clip start |
| `enabled` | boolean |  | On (true) or off (false) |
| `index` | integer (0 to 50) |  | Position from the top, 0 is first |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Preview: return what would change without changing anything |
| `expectRevision` | integer (at least 0) |  | Refuse if the project changed since you read this revision (from any read tool) |

Example (Black and white): `{"clip":"clip_abc","effect":"color","params":{"saturation":-1}}`
Example: `{"clip":"clip_abc","effect":"fx_123","enabled":false}`

### `remove_effect`: Remove an effect

Remove one effect from a clip (by id, or by type for the first of that type), or all of them with effect:"all".

*Changes the project (one undo step; asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clip` | string | yes | Clip id (from get_timeline) |
| `effect` | string | yes | Effect id (from get_clip) or its type |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Preview: return what would change without changing anything |
| `expectRevision` | integer (at least 0) |  | Refuse if the project changed since you read this revision (from any read tool) |

Example: `{"clip":"clip_abc","effect":"fx_123"}`
Example: `{"clip":"clip_abc","effect":"all"}`

### `copy_effects`: Copy a look to other clips

Paste the effects of one clip (its whole look: grade, LUT, vignette and so on) onto other clips, replacing or adding to theirs. Time-based effects (zoom) are skipped unless includeTimed is true.

*Changes the project (one undo step; asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | string | yes | Start of the range, timeline seconds |
| `to` | string[] | yes | End of the range, timeline seconds |
| `mode` | "replace" \| "append" |  | Mode |
| `includeTimed` | boolean |  | Also copy time-based effects such as zoom |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Preview: return what would change without changing anything |
| `expectRevision` | integer (at least 0) |  | Refuse if the project changed since you read this revision (from any read tool) |

Example: `{"from":"clip_graded","to":["clip_b","clip_c"]}`

### `set_transition`: Set a transition

Set the transition into a clip from the clip before it on the same lane: crossfade, dissolve, dip-black, dip-white, slide-left, slide-up, zoom, whip. duration in seconds (default 0.4). type:"none" removes it. A clip that starts a lane fades in from black (dip-black) or from what is below.

*Changes the project (one undo step; asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clips` | string[] | yes | Clip ids (from get_timeline) |
| `type` | "none" \| "crossfade" \| "dissolve" \| "dip-black" \| "dip-white" \| "slide-left" \| "slide-up" \| "zoom" \| "whip" | yes | Type |
| `duration` | number (0.04 to 5) |  | Length in seconds |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Preview: return what would change without changing anything |
| `expectRevision` | integer (at least 0) |  | Refuse if the project changed since you read this revision (from any read tool) |

Example: `{"clips":["clip_b"],"type":"crossfade","duration":0.3}`
Example: `{"clips":["clip_b","clip_c"],"type":"whip","duration":0.25}`

## Titles, text and captions

### `add_text`: Add a title or text

Add a text clip (title, label, lower third, call to action) at `start` seconds for `duration` seconds on the titles lane (or `lane`). x/y move it in project pixels from the frame center (+y is down). Defaults: Inter 96 px, weight 900, white with a black outline, pops in and fades out. Animations: fade, pop, slide-up, slide-left, zoom, typewriter. Animate position or scale with set_keyframes.

*Changes the project (one undo step; asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | yes | The words |
| `start` | number (0 to 36000) | yes | Timeline start in seconds |
| `duration` | number (0.04 to 36000) |  | Seconds (default 3) |
| `lane` | string |  | Lane id, or a lane kind (camera, screen, broll, graphics, titles, captions, voice, music, sfx) |
| `x` | number |  | Pixels from the frame center, + is right |
| `y` | number |  | Pixels from the frame center, + is down |
| `name` | string |  | Name |
| `font` | string |  | Font family, e.g. Inter |
| `size` | number (8 to 600) |  | Font size in project pixels (a 1080x1920 frame: 60 small, 96 bold title) |
| `weight` | integer (100 to 1000) |  | Font weight 100 to 1000 (900 is black) |
| `color` | string |  | A color like #ffcc00 |
| `highlightColor` | string |  | Color of the word being spoken (captions) |
| `align` | "left" \| "center" \| "right" |  | Text alignment |
| `uppercase` | boolean |  | Show in capitals |
| `stroke` | object or null |  | Outline; null removes it |
| `shadow` | object or null |  | Drop shadow; null removes it |
| `box` | object or null |  | Background box behind the text; null removes it |
| `lineHeight` | number (0.6 to 4) |  | Line spacing (1 is tight) |
| `maxWidth` | number (0.1 to 1) |  | Wrap width as a fraction of the frame width |
| `animationIn` | "fade" \| "pop" \| "slide-up" \| "slide-left" \| "zoom" \| "typewriter" \| "none" |  | Entrance animation, or "none" |
| `animationOut` | "fade" \| "pop" \| "slide-up" \| "slide-left" \| "zoom" \| "typewriter" \| "none" |  | Exit animation, or "none" |
| `animationDuration` | number (0 to 5) |  | Seconds for the in and out animations |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Preview: return what would change without changing anything |
| `expectRevision` | integer (at least 0) |  | Refuse if the project changed since you read this revision (from any read tool) |

Example (Hook title near the top): `{"text":"Stop typing plain prompts","start":0.2,"duration":2.8,"y":-620}`
Example: `{"text":"Follow for part 2","start":24,"duration":3,"box":{"color":"rgba(0,0,0,0.7)","padding":24,"radius":18},"size":64,"animationIn":"slide-up"}`

### `update_text`: Edit text or its style

Change the words and/or style of text or caption clips: content, font, size, weight, colors, outline, shadow, box, alignment, uppercase, wrap width and in/out animations. Changing a caption's words drops its word timing (the highlight then covers the whole card).

*Changes the project (one undo step; asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clips` | string[] | yes | Clip ids (from get_timeline) |
| `text` | string |  | The words |
| `font` | string |  | Font family, e.g. Inter |
| `size` | number (8 to 600) |  | Font size in project pixels (a 1080x1920 frame: 60 small, 96 bold title) |
| `weight` | integer (100 to 1000) |  | Font weight 100 to 1000 (900 is black) |
| `color` | string |  | A color like #ffcc00 |
| `highlightColor` | string |  | Color of the word being spoken (captions) |
| `align` | "left" \| "center" \| "right" |  | Text alignment |
| `uppercase` | boolean |  | Show in capitals |
| `stroke` | object or null |  | Outline; null removes it |
| `shadow` | object or null |  | Drop shadow; null removes it |
| `box` | object or null |  | Background box behind the text; null removes it |
| `lineHeight` | number (0.6 to 4) |  | Line spacing (1 is tight) |
| `maxWidth` | number (0.1 to 1) |  | Wrap width as a fraction of the frame width |
| `animationIn` | "fade" \| "pop" \| "slide-up" \| "slide-left" \| "zoom" \| "typewriter" \| "none" |  | Entrance animation, or "none" |
| `animationOut` | "fade" \| "pop" \| "slide-up" \| "slide-left" \| "zoom" \| "typewriter" \| "none" |  | Exit animation, or "none" |
| `animationDuration` | number (0 to 5) |  | Seconds for the in and out animations |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Preview: return what would change without changing anything |
| `expectRevision` | integer (at least 0) |  | Refuse if the project changed since you read this revision (from any read tool) |

Example: `{"clips":["clip_title"],"text":"Here is the trick","color":"#f5e23d"}`
Example: `{"clips":["clip_title"],"animationIn":"typewriter","animationDuration":0.6}`

### `add_shape`: Add a shape

Add a solid rectangle or ellipse (for highlights, bars, frames behind text) on the graphics lane at `start` for `duration` seconds (default 3). size is its width as a fraction of the frame (it keeps the frame's aspect; stretch it with set_clip scale or keyframes); x/y in project pixels from center; radius rounds rectangle corners.

*Changes the project (one undo step; asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `shape` | "rect" \| "ellipse" | yes | Shape |
| `color` | string | yes | A color like #ffcc00 |
| `start` | number (0 to 36000) | yes | Timeline start in seconds |
| `duration` | number (0.04 to 36000) |  | Length in seconds |
| `size` | number (0.01 to 4) |  | Size |
| `radius` | number (0 to 500) |  | Corner radius in pixels |
| `x` | number |  | Pixels from the frame center, + is right |
| `y` | number |  | Pixels from the frame center, + is down |
| `opacity` | number (0 to 1) |  | 0 transparent to 1 opaque |
| `lane` | string |  | Lane id, or a lane kind (camera, screen, broll, graphics, titles, captions, voice, music, sfx) |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Preview: return what would change without changing anything |
| `expectRevision` | integer (at least 0) |  | Refuse if the project changed since you read this revision (from any read tool) |

Example: `{"shape":"rect","color":"#f5e23d","start":2,"duration":2,"size":0.6,"radius":24,"y":500,"opacity":0.9}`

### `add_placeholder`: Add a b-roll placeholder

Mark a slot for footage you do not have yet: a labelled placeholder on the b-roll lane from `start` for `duration` seconds (default 2.5), also listed in the shot list. Replace it later by add_clip on the same range.

*Changes the project (one undo step; asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | string | yes | Shown to the person |
| `start` | number (0 to 36000) | yes | Timeline start in seconds |
| `duration` | number (0.04 to 600) |  | Length in seconds |
| `lane` | string |  | Lane id, or a lane kind (camera, screen, broll, graphics, titles, captions, voice, music, sfx) |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Preview: return what would change without changing anything |
| `expectRevision` | integer (at least 0) |  | Refuse if the project changed since you read this revision (from any read tool) |

Example: `{"label":"B-roll: typing on laptop","start":6.1,"duration":2.5}`

### `generate_captions`: Generate captions

Make burned-in captions from the transcript (transcribe first), replacing existing ones. style: word-pop, karaoke, boxed, clean, bold-yellow. maxWords and maxChars size each card; cards break at pauses and sentence ends and never cross a cut; position is the vertical center as a fraction of the frame height (default per style, inside the platform safe zone).

*Changes the project (one undo step; asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `style` | "word-pop" \| "karaoke" \| "boxed" \| "clean" \| "bold-yellow" |  | Style preset |
| `maxWords` | integer (1 to 12) |  | Most words per caption card |
| `maxChars` | integer (6 to 80) |  | Most characters per caption card |
| `position` | number (0.1 to 0.9) |  | Vertical center as a fraction of the frame height |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Preview: return what would change without changing anything |
| `expectRevision` | integer (at least 0) |  | Refuse if the project changed since you read this revision (from any read tool) |

Example: `{"style":"word-pop","maxWords":3}`
Example: `{"style":"boxed","position":0.72}`

### `style_captions`: Restyle all captions

Change the look of every caption at once, keeping their words and timing: apply a preset (word-pop, karaoke, boxed, clean, bold-yellow) and/or override any style field, and move them with position (fraction of frame height).

*Changes the project (one undo step; asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `style` | "word-pop" \| "karaoke" \| "boxed" \| "clean" \| "bold-yellow" |  | Style preset |
| `position` | number (0.1 to 0.9) |  | Vertical center as a fraction of the frame height |
| `font` | string |  | Font family, e.g. Inter |
| `size` | number (8 to 600) |  | Font size in project pixels (a 1080x1920 frame: 60 small, 96 bold title) |
| `weight` | integer (100 to 1000) |  | Font weight 100 to 1000 (900 is black) |
| `color` | string |  | A color like #ffcc00 |
| `highlightColor` | string |  | Color of the word being spoken (captions) |
| `align` | "left" \| "center" \| "right" |  | Text alignment |
| `uppercase` | boolean |  | Show in capitals |
| `stroke` | object or null |  | Outline; null removes it |
| `shadow` | object or null |  | Drop shadow; null removes it |
| `box` | object or null |  | Background box behind the text; null removes it |
| `lineHeight` | number (0.6 to 4) |  | Line spacing (1 is tight) |
| `maxWidth` | number (0.1 to 1) |  | Wrap width as a fraction of the frame width |
| `animationIn` | "fade" \| "pop" \| "slide-up" \| "slide-left" \| "zoom" \| "typewriter" \| "none" |  | Entrance animation, or "none" |
| `animationOut` | "fade" \| "pop" \| "slide-up" \| "slide-left" \| "zoom" \| "typewriter" \| "none" |  | Exit animation, or "none" |
| `animationDuration` | number (0 to 5) |  | Seconds for the in and out animations |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Preview: return what would change without changing anything |
| `expectRevision` | integer (at least 0) |  | Refuse if the project changed since you read this revision (from any read tool) |

Example: `{"style":"karaoke"}`
Example: `{"highlightColor":"#ff4d6d","size":80,"position":0.6}`

## Audio mixing

### `set_audio`: Mix a clip's audio

Set audio on clips: volume in dB (0 = unchanged, -6 = half as loud, +6 louder; range -60 to +24), pan (-1 left to 1 right), fadeIn/fadeOut in seconds, muted, and duckUnderVoice (music dips automatically wherever someone speaks). Animate volume over time with set_keyframes property "volume".

*Changes the project (one undo step; asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clips` | string[] | yes | Clip ids (from get_timeline) |
| `volume` | number (-60 to 24) |  | Gain in dB (0 unchanged, -6 half as loud) |
| `pan` | number (-1 to 1) |  | -1 left to 1 right |
| `fadeIn` | number (0 to 60) |  | Fade-in length in seconds |
| `fadeOut` | number (0 to 60) |  | Fade-out length in seconds |
| `muted` | boolean |  | Silence it |
| `duckUnderVoice` | boolean |  | Dip automatically under speech |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Preview: return what would change without changing anything |
| `expectRevision` | integer (at least 0) |  | Refuse if the project changed since you read this revision (from any read tool) |

Example (Music bed under a voiceover): `{"clips":["clip_music"],"volume":-14,"duckUnderVoice":true,"fadeIn":1,"fadeOut":2.5}`
Example: `{"clips":["clip_camera"],"muted":true}`

### `process_audio`: Clean up or enhance a voice

Remove background noise (denoise) and/or enhance a voice (EQ and compression) on a clip; the processed copy replaces its sound as one undo step (a video clip keeps its picture and gets the clean voice on the voice lane).

*Acts in the app or writes files (asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clip` | string | yes | Clip id (from get_timeline) |
| `denoise` | boolean |  | Remove background noise |
| `enhance` | boolean |  | EQ and compress the voice |

Example: `{"clip":"clip_camera","denoise":true,"enhance":true}`

### `detect_beats`: Mark the beats

Find the beats of a music clip and drop "beat" markers on the timeline, to cut on the beat (get_timeline lists them; remove_marker {"kind":"beat"} clears them).

*Acts in the app or writes files (asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clip` | string | yes | Clip id (from get_timeline) |

Example: `{"clip":"clip_music"}`

## Lanes, markers, canvas and templates

### `add_lane`: Add a lane

Add a lane (track). Kinds: graphics, titles, captions, broll, screen, camera, voice, music, sfx. Lanes higher in the list draw on top. Default position: with the other lanes of its kind.

*Changes the project (one undo step; asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | "graphics" \| "titles" \| "captions" \| "broll" \| "screen" \| "camera" \| "voice" \| "music" \| "sfx" | yes | Kind |
| `name` | string |  | Name |
| `index` | integer (0 to 100) |  | Position from the top, 0 is first |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Preview: return what would change without changing anything |
| `expectRevision` | integer (at least 0) |  | Refuse if the project changed since you read this revision (from any read tool) |

Example: `{"kind":"broll","name":"B-roll 2"}`

### `update_lane`: Lane settings

Rename a lane, mute or solo its sound, hide its picture, or lock it against edits.

*Changes the project (one undo step; asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lane` | string | yes | Lane id, or a lane kind (camera, screen, broll, graphics, titles, captions, voice, music, sfx) |
| `name` | string |  | Name |
| `muted` | boolean |  | Silence it |
| `solo` | boolean |  | Hear only soloed lanes |
| `hidden` | boolean |  | Hide its picture |
| `locked` | boolean |  | Protect it from edits |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Preview: return what would change without changing anything |
| `expectRevision` | integer (at least 0) |  | Refuse if the project changed since you read this revision (from any read tool) |

Example: `{"lane":"music","muted":true}`
Example: `{"lane":"camera","locked":true}`

### `remove_lane`: Remove a lane

Remove a lane. A lane with clips is only removed with force:true (its clips go too; undoable).

*Changes the project (one undo step; asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lane` | string | yes | Lane id, or a lane kind (camera, screen, broll, graphics, titles, captions, voice, music, sfx) |
| `force` | boolean |  | Do it even though it removes content |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Preview: return what would change without changing anything |
| `expectRevision` | integer (at least 0) |  | Refuse if the project changed since you read this revision (from any read tool) |

Example: `{"lane":"lane_123"}`

### `move_lane`: Reorder a lane

Move a lane to position `index` (0 is the top, drawn over everything below).

*Changes the project (one undo step; asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lane` | string | yes | Lane id, or a lane kind (camera, screen, broll, graphics, titles, captions, voice, music, sfx) |

| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Preview: return what would change without changing anything |
| `expectRevision` | integer (at least 0) |  | Refuse if the project changed since you read this revision (from any read tool) |

Example: `{"lane":"titles","index":0}`

### `add_marker`: Add a marker

Drop a marker at a timeline time with a label, for notes, chapters or beats. Kinds: note, retake, cue, chapter, beat, good, bad. Optional duration in seconds marks a range.

Change the project frame: preset (vertical-1080, landscape-1080, landscape-4k, square-1080, portrait-4x5) or width/height in pixels, fps (24, 25, 30, 50, 60, 29.97, 59.94), and the background behind everything: a color, or blur (a blurred, zoomed copy of the video fills the empty space, for landscape footage in a vertical frame).

Rename the project or change its settings: snapping, ripple by default (what the person's own edits do), and the platform safe zone captions avoid (reels, tiktok, shorts, none).

### `apply_template`: Apply a saved template

Place a saved template (a group of titles, shapes and graphics saved from the Text panel or save_template) at `at` seconds, filling its text slots in order with `texts`. list_templates shows what exists.

Templates saved from the Text panel or save_template: id, name, length (s) and how many text slots they have.

No arguments.

Save clips (titles, shapes, graphics) as a reusable template; their text becomes fill-in slots for apply_template.

## Text-based editing and automation

### `cut_words`: Cut words (text-based editing)

Remove spoken words from the edit like deleting text: by `text` (a phrase to find; occurrence picks which match, default the first, or "all"), or by word index range (first/last from get_transcript, inclusive), or a list of indices. Picture, sound and captions are cut together (ripple) at word boundaries, with tiny fades so joins do not click.

*Changes the project (one undo step; asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string |  | The words |
| `occurrence` | integer (1 to 1000) or "all" |  | Which match (1 is the first) or "all" |
| `first` | integer (at least 0) |  | First word index (from get_transcript) |
| `last` | integer (at least 0) |  | Last word index, inclusive |
| `indices` | integer (0 to 9007199254740991)[] |  | Word indices (from get_transcript) |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Preview: return what would change without changing anything |
| `expectRevision` | integer (at least 0) |  | Refuse if the project changed since you read this revision (from any read tool) |

Example: `{"text":"you know","occurrence":"all"}`
Example: `{"first":12,"last":18}`

### `auto_cut`: AutoCut pauses and fillers

Tighten a talking-head edit: shorten pauses longer than minPause seconds (default 0.35), keeping keep seconds (default 0.08) of air at each side; remove filler words (default: um, uh, uhm, umm, erm, er, ah, hmm, mm, mhm; pass false to keep them or your own list); trim silence before the first and after the last word. Use dryRun to see the ranges first. Needs a transcript.

*Changes the project (one undo step; asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `minPause` | number (0.05 to 10) |  | Seconds; pauses longer than this are shortened |
| `keep` | number (0 to 1) |  | Seconds of air kept each side of a cut |
| `fillers` | boolean or string[] |  | true (default list), false, or your own filler words |
| `trimEnds` | boolean |  | Also trim silence before the first and after the last word |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Preview: return what would change without changing anything |
| `expectRevision` | integer (at least 0) |  | Refuse if the project changed since you read this revision (from any read tool) |

Example (Defaults): `{}`
Example: `{"minPause":0.5,"fillers":false,"dryRun":true}`

### `make_reel`: Make Reel (one-click rough cut)

The whole automatic pass in one undo step: vertical 1080x1920, keep the best take of each script line (when a script is attached), AutoCut pauses and fillers, turn ZOOM and B-ROLL cues into punch-ins and placeholders, then captions. Needs a transcript. Good first pass; refine with the other tools.

*Changes the project (one undo step; asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `captionStyle` | "word-pop" \| "karaoke" \| "boxed" \| "clean" \| "bold-yellow" |  | Caption style preset |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Preview: return what would change without changing anything |
| `expectRevision` | integer (at least 0) |  | Refuse if the project changed since you read this revision (from any read tool) |

Example: `{}`
Example: `{"captionStyle":"boxed","dryRun":true}`

## Media import and processing

### `import_media`: Import media files

Add video, audio or image files (absolute paths on this Mac, or folders) to the project bin. Returns media ids for add_clip. role sets the natural lane: camera, screen, mic (voice), broll, music, sfx, image. Files already in the project are reported, not duplicated.

*Acts in the app or writes files (asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `paths` | string[] | yes | Absolute file or folder paths on this Mac |
| `role` | "camera" \| "screen" \| "mic" \| "broll" \| "music" \| "sfx" \| "image" \| "other" |  | What the media is; decides its natural lane |

Example: `{"paths":["/Users/me/Movies/broll/laptop.mov"],"role":"broll"}`

### `browse_files`: Browse the media folder

List what is in the content folder the person opened in the Files panel (or a folder inside it), or search below it by words in the path. Folders and video, audio and image files come back with absolute paths, sizes, whether each is already in the project, and the role its category folder suggests (a "Music" folder suggests music, "SFX" sfx, "B-roll" broll, "Screen recordings" screen). Then import_media {paths, role} and add_clip. Only folders the person opened can be browsed.

*Reads only; never asks.*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `folder` | string |  | A folder inside an opened folder; default the opened folder itself |
| `query` | string |  | Words that must all appear in the path below the opened folder, e.g. "drone sunset" |
| `kind` | "video" \| "audio" \| "image" |  | Kind |

Example: `{}`
Example (find sound effects anywhere below the folder): `{"query":"whoosh","kind":"audio"}`

### `list_takes`: Recorded takes

Takes recorded with the teleprompter for this project, newest first: id, title, length (seconds), star rating, how many retake and cue markers, whether a screen recording and a script came with it. add_take puts one on the timeline.

*Reads only; never asks.*

No arguments.

Example: `{}`

### `add_take`: Put a take on the timeline

Put a recorded take (id from list_takes) at the end of the timeline: camera on the camera lane, its sound linked on the voice lane, the screen recording in sync on the screen lane, retake and cue markers at their times, and its script attached. Then transcribe and make_reel or edit by hand.

*Acts in the app or writes files (asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `take` | string | yes | Take id or title (from list_takes) |

Example: `{"take":"take_1"}`

### `transcribe`: Transcribe speech

Transcribe the speech on the timeline locally (whisper, nothing leaves this Mac) and store word timings in the project; needed for get_transcript, cut_words, auto_cut, captions and make_reel. Finds speech clips by itself; media limits it; force redoes existing transcripts. Can take a minute per few minutes of audio.

*Acts in the app or writes files (asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `media` | string[] |  | Media id or exact name (from list_media) |
| `force` | boolean |  | Do it even though it removes content |
| `model` | string |  | Transcription model id (default: the best installed) |

Example: `{}`

### `auto_reframe`: Auto reframe

Track the face in a wide video clip and keyframe its position so the person stays centered in a vertical frame.

*Acts in the app or writes files (asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clip` | string | yes | Clip id (from get_timeline) |

Example: `{"clip":"clip_camera"}`

### `detect_speakers`: Who is talking when

Find the people in a video clip (one camera, or a split-screen remote interview with up to three people side by side) and who speaks when, from lip movement matched to the transcript. Returns each person's panel (left to right, normalized), seconds of talk per person, how clear the signal was (confidence 0 to 1) and sample turns with their words, so you can tell who is who. Needs the transcript (transcribe). The first run on a long video takes a few minutes; later runs are instant.

*Reads only; never asks.*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clip` | string | yes | Clip id (from get_timeline) |
| `from` | number (0 to 36000) |  | Timeline seconds to start from (default the clip start) |
| `to` | number (0 to 36000) |  | Timeline seconds to stop at (default the clip end) |

Example: `{"clip":"clip_camera"}`
Example: `{"clip":"clip_camera","from":55,"to":300}`

### `speaker_layout`: Cut to whoever is talking

Edit an interview or podcast clip like a multicam: a close shot of whoever is talking, everyone side by side (each filling half the frame) during quick back-and-forth, and long answers broken at pauses with alternating wide and tight framing so the picture keeps moving. Works on split-screen remote recordings (it crops each person out of their panel, removing letterbox bars) and on single-camera footage (alternating framing only). Shots are muted copies on "Speakers" lanes above the clip, so the original keeps the sound and running it again replaces the earlier layout. One undo step. Needs the transcript. Times (from, to, minShot, maxShot) are in seconds. dryRun reports the plan without changing anything.

*Acts in the app or writes files (asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clip` | string | yes | Clip id (from get_timeline) |
| `from` | number (0 to 36000) |  | Timeline seconds to start from (default the clip start); use it to leave an edited intro alone |
| `to` | number (0 to 36000) |  | Timeline seconds to stop at (default the clip end) |
| `minShot` | number (1 to 20) |  | Shortest shot in seconds (default 2.5) |
| `maxShot` | number (3 to 120) |  | Longest single framing in seconds before it changes (default 9) |
| `punchIn` | number (0 to 1) |  | How much closer the tight framing is, 0 to 1 (default 0.18 = 18% closer; 0 = no punch-ins) |
| `splitOnExchange` | boolean |  | Show everyone side by side during quick exchanges (default true) |
| `reactionEvery` | integer (0 to 20) |  | In a long answer, every Nth framing shows everyone so the listener reacts on screen (default 4; 0 = never) |
| `names` | string[] |  | Names of the people left to right, for clip names |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | Report the plan without changing anything |

Example (Leave the first 55 s alone): `{"clip":"clip_camera","from":55}`
Example: `{"clip":"clip_camera","punchIn":0.25,"maxShot":7,"names":["Sam","Alex"],"dryRun":true}`

### `remove_background`: Remove background

Cut the person out of a video clip (on-device segmentation) so lanes below show behind them. Takes a while on long clips.

*Acts in the app or writes files (asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clip` | string | yes | Clip id (from get_timeline) |

Example: `{"clip":"clip_camera"}`

### `stabilize`: Stabilize

Smooth out handheld shake in a video clip (two-pass); the stabilized copy replaces the clip's source. smoothing 1 to 100 (default 15).

*Acts in the app or writes files (asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clip` | string | yes | Clip id (from get_timeline) |
| `smoothing` | integer (1 to 100) |  | Smoothing strength 1 to 100 |

Example: `{"clip":"clip_broll"}`

## Seeing the edit

### `render_frame`: See a frame

A PNG of the finished edit at time t (seconds): every lane, effect, transition, text and caption, as it will export. width in pixels (default 540).

*Reads only; never asks.*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `t` | number (0 to 36000) | yes | Timeline time in seconds |
| `width` | integer (64 to 2160) |  | Width in pixels |

Example: `{"t":5}`

### `render_contact_sheet`: See the whole edit at a glance

One PNG grid of `count` frames evenly spaced from `from` to `to` seconds (default the whole timeline), each labelled with its time. The cheapest way to check an edit visually.

*Reads only; never asks.*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | number (0 to 36000) |  | Start of the range, timeline seconds |
| `to` | number (0 to 36000) |  | End of the range, timeline seconds |
| `count` | integer (1 to 48) |  | How many frames |
| `columns` | integer (1 to 12) |  | Grid columns |
| `width` | integer (256 to 4096) |  | Width of the whole sheet in pixels (default 1200) |

Example: `{"count":12}`
Example: `{"from":0,"to":6,"count":6,"columns":6}`

## Exporting

### `export_video`: Export the video

Render the edit to an MP4 in the export folder. preset: reels-30, reels-60, youtube-1080, youtube-4k, square-1080 (the project's shape decides the exact size). fileName is a plain name ending in .mp4 (default: the project name). from/to (seconds) export part of the timeline. normalizeLoudness (default true) sets -14 LUFS for social platforms. Returns a job id; poll get_export_status.

*Acts in the app or writes files (asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `preset` | "reels-30" \| "reels-60" \| "youtube-1080" \| "youtube-4k" \| "square-1080" |  | Preset name |
| `fileName` | string |  | A plain file name; written to the export folder |
| `from` | number (0 to 36000) |  | Start of the range, timeline seconds |
| `to` | number (0 to 36000) |  | End of the range, timeline seconds |
| `normalizeLoudness` | boolean |  | Set -14 LUFS for social platforms (default true) |

Example: `{"preset":"reels-30"}`
Example: `{"preset":"youtube-1080","fileName":"final.mp4","from":0,"to":30}`

### `get_export_status`: Export progress

Status of export jobs (queued, audio, rendering, finishing, done, error, cancelled) with progress 0 to 1, and for finished ones the file, size, loudness and length. job narrows to one.

*Reads only; never asks.*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `job` | string |  | Export job id (from export_video) |

Example: `{}`

### `cancel_export`: Cancel an export

Stop a queued or running export job (job id from export_video); its partial file is removed.

*Acts in the app or writes files (asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `job` | string | yes | Export job id (from export_video) |

Example: `{"job":"exp_123"}`

### `export_subtitles`: Export subtitles

Write the captions as an SRT or WebVTT file into the export folder (for platforms that take subtitle files).

*Acts in the app or writes files (asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `format` | "srt" \| "vtt" | yes | File format |
| `fileName` | string |  | A plain file name; written to the export folder |

Example: `{"format":"srt"}`

### `export_chapters`: Export YouTube chapters

Write the chapter markers as a YouTube chapter list ("0:00 Intro" lines, ready to paste into the video description) into the export folder, and return the text. YouTube needs the first chapter at 0:00 (firstTitle names it when no chapter starts there), at least 3 chapters, each at least 10 seconds long; problems lists anything that breaks those rules.

*Acts in the app or writes files (asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fileName` | string |  | A plain file name; written to the export folder |
| `firstTitle` | string |  | Title for a 0:00 chapter when no chapter marker starts there (default "Intro") |

Example: `{}`
Example: `{"fileName":"chapters.txt","firstTitle":"Cold open"}`

### `export_still`: Save a still or cover

Save a full-resolution PNG of the edit at time t (seconds), for a cover or thumbnail, into the export folder.

*Acts in the app or writes files (asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `t` | number (0 to 36000) | yes | Timeline time in seconds |
| `fileName` | string |  | A plain file name; written to the export folder |

Example: `{"t":1.2,"fileName":"cover.png"}`

### `create_project`: New project

Create and open a new empty project. preset: vertical-1080 (default), landscape-1080, landscape-4k, square-1080, portrait-4x5; fps: 24, 25, 29.97, 30 (default), 50, 59.94, 60.

*Acts in the app or writes files (asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | Name |
| `preset` | string |  | Preset name |
| `fps` | string |  | Frame rate |

Example: `{"name":"Prompting reel"}`

### `seek`: Move the playhead

Move the playhead to t seconds so the person sees that moment in the preview.

*Reads only; never asks.*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `t` | number (0 to 36000) | yes | Timeline time in seconds |

Example: `{"t":12.5}`

### `play`: Play

Start playback from the playhead (seek first to choose where).

*Reads only; never asks.*

No arguments.

Example: `{}`

### `pause`: Pause

Stop playback; the playhead stays where it stopped (get_state reports it).

*Reads only; never asks.*

No arguments.

Example: `{}`

### `select_clips`: Select clips

Select clips in the timeline (empty list clears), to point the person at what you are talking about.

*Reads only; never asks.*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clips` | string[] | yes | Clip ids (from get_timeline) |

Example: `{"clips":["clip_abc"]}`

### `show_workspace`: Switch workspace

Show a workspace in the window: swipe, script, record, edit or export (the edit tools work whichever is showing).

*Reads only; never asks.*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `workspace` | "swipe" \| "script" \| "record" \| "edit" \| "export" | yes | Which workspace to show |

Example: `{"workspace":"edit"}`

## Swipe references, scripts and sounds

### `list_audio_library`: Music and sound effects

Music and sound effects in the person's audio folders: name, kind (music or sfx), length and path. Import one with import_media then add_clip.

*Reads only; never asks.*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | "music" \| "sfx" |  | Kind |
| `query` | string |  | Search text |

Example: `{"kind":"music","query":"upbeat"}`

### `list_references`: Swipe references

Reference reels saved in the Swipe library for the active brand: id, title, stats, tags, and pacing if analyzed. query searches titles and notes.

*Reads only; never asks.*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string |  | Search text |
| `tag` | string |  | Only references with this tag |

Example: `{}`

### `get_reference`: Read a reference

One Swipe reference: stats, notes, pacing (shots, cuts per minute, words per second), structure labels (hook, setup, payoff, CTA) and transcript, to model an edit on it.

*Reads only; never asks.*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Id from the matching list tool |

Example: `{"id":"ref_123"}`

### `list_scripts`: Scripts

Scripts in the Script studio for the active brand: id, title, current version, words per minute and target length.

*Reads only; never asks.*

No arguments.

Example: `{}`

### `get_script`: Read a script

A script's current text (with its [CUES]), version, words per minute and target length; version picks an older one.

*Reads only; never asks.*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Id from the matching list tool |
| `version` | integer (at least 1) |  | Version number (default: the current one) |

Example: `{"id":"scr_123"}`

### `attach_script`: Attach a script to the project

Link a script (and version) to the open project, so make_reel picks the best take of each line and cues (ZOOM, B-ROLL) become edits.

*Acts in the app or writes files (asks first in Ask mode).*

| Argument | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Id from the matching list tool |
| `version` | integer (at least 1) |  | Version number (default: the current one) |

Example: `{"id":"scr_123"}`

## What stays with the person

Every command in the app is reachable by a tool except these, on purpose:

- `edit.toolSelect`: Mouse pointer mode; agents act on clips by id.
- `edit.zoomIn`: Timeline view zoom; agents see the edit with render_contact_sheet.
- `edit.zoomOut`: Timeline view zoom; agents see the edit with render_contact_sheet.
- `edit.zoomFit`: Timeline view zoom; agents see the edit with render_contact_sheet.
- `edit.loop`: Playback looping is a viewing preference.
- `files.openFolder`: choosing which folder to open is the person's decision; agents browse the folders they opened with browse_files.
- `assistant.open`: opens the in-app assistant chat, which is itself an agent driving these same tools.
- `record.start`: Recording needs the person in front of the camera; agents edit takes once they are recorded.
- `record.stop`: Recording needs the person in front of the camera.
- `record.prompter`: The teleprompter is for the person recording.
- `record.prompterClose`: The teleprompter is for the person recording.
- `record.follow`: Teleprompter scrolling mode.
- `record.wpm`: Teleprompter scrolling mode.
- `script.new`: Scripts are written in the Script workspace; agents read them with list_scripts and get_script and attach them with attach_script.
- `script.draft`: In-app Claude drafting; an external agent writes its own drafts and reads scripts with get_script.
- `script.hooks`: In-app Claude hook writing; agents read scripts with get_script.
- `settings.open`: Agents cannot open or change their own permissions.
- `swipe.import`: The person curates their reference library; agents read it with list_references and get_reference.
